headline: ARI @ SEA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 3.49 at SEA 3.55, with a projected total of 7.04. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SEA: ARI moved -0.32 runs while SEA moved -0.12, changing the projected margin by -0.20 runs. The projected total fell -0.43, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: George Kirby has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ketel Marte, Corbin Carroll, Julio Rodríguez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jorge Barrosa, Rob Refsnyder because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
